decisions.reason: As a specialist naval lighting system that remained on the website through 2024, A likely met a satisfactory niche aspiration level and a large German engineering firm has enough slack to retain it unless demand clearly weakens.

C is in the firm's core interior-lighting business, but its lower prominence in 2024 suggests only moderate performance versus aspiration, so management would keep it for now while remaining more open to portfolio rationalisation.
D was still actively highlighted in 2024 as a latest release, which indicates results at or above aspiration and gives management little reason to search for an alternative use of its resources.

Because F stayed on the website while another marine searchlight variant disappeared, it likely cleared the firm's aspiration threshold within this specialist segment and is therefore more likely to be retained than dropped.
